figurative_meaning_bn: আকাট মূর্খ; নিরেট বোকা; অক্ষরপরিচয় পর্যন্ত নেই এমন
figurative_meaning_en: utter fool; complete idiot; someone utterly ignorant even of basics like the alphabet
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এত গোমূর্খ যে সাধারণ অক্ষরও চিনতে পারে না।
এই গোমূর্খের কথা কেউ শোনে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is such a gomurkha that he can't even recognize basic letters.
No one listens to this gomurkha's advice.
history: Derives from the perception of cows as simple-minded animals in rural Bengali life, emphasizing extreme stupidity.
note: The idiom highlights profound ignorance, often used in colloquial speech to mock lack of basic knowledge.
